header.label: OpenAEC Ecosystem
header.title: Open CAD Studio
header.desc: Experimental 2D CAD framework — foundation for the next generation of OpenAEC CAD tools. Lightweight rendering, command system and plugin architecture.

what.title: What is Open CAD Studio?
what.desc: Open CAD Studio is an experimental 2D CAD framework that serves as the technological foundation for the next generation of open-source CAD tools within the OpenAEC ecosystem. Where Open 2D Studio delivers a complete toolchain, Open CAD Studio acts as a research framework and architecture platform: what does an open, modular and performant CAD engine look like?
what.list1: Lightweight rendering — canvas-based 2D engine, fast even with large drawings
what.list2: Command system — CAD-style command input with undo/redo and macros
what.list3: Plugin architecture — extensible via add-ins for specific domains
what.list4: DXF / SVG interoperability — readable between Open CAD Studio and the wider CAD world
what.list5: Open-source research — a playground for patterns that later land in Open 2D Studio

why.title: Why a separate framework?
why.desc1: Open 2D Studio is a production CAD application. We want stability there, not experiments. Open CAD Studio gives us room to explore radically different architectural choices — alternative rendering strategies, data models, interaction patterns — without destabilizing the production tool.
why.desc2: What turns out to work here migrates to Open 2D Studio. What doesn't work, we learn from without affecting users.

engine.title: Rendering engine
engine.desc: Canvas 2D as baseline with a viewport and transform stack that scales to hundreds of thousands of entities. WebGPU experiment for the hot loop in research.

command.title: Command structure
command.desc: CAD-style commands with arguments, options and preview state. Undo/redo via a journal of inverse commands.

plugins.title: Plugin API
plugins.desc: Add-ins can register commands, add ribbon tabs and define their own entity types. TypeScript-driven contract with runtime validation.

snap.title: Snapping & constraints
snap.desc: Object snap (endpoint, midpoint, intersection) plus parametric constraints — distance, parallel, perpendicular — as a research area.

data.title: Data model
data.desc: Immutable entity tree with structural sharing. Time travel for sessions and collaborative editing as future goals.

io.title: DXF / SVG I/O
io.desc: Read and write DXF via a Rust backend. SVG export for presentation and web embedding.

tech.title: Technology
tech.desc: The same baseline stack as all OpenAEC tools: TypeScript for the UI, Rust for the performance-critical paths, Tauri 2 for cross-platform desktop distribution (Windows, macOS, Linux).
